outputs.explanation: Panel A shows spatial deconvolution heatmaps overlaid on tissue sections (per-spot values across the tissue), not a bar/summary plot of averaged replicate data; individual spot-level values are already displayed spatially, so overlay of individual points is not applicable.

Panel B is a box plot showing the distribution of values with individual data points (dots for each spot/replicate) overlaid on the boxes, satisfying the requirement even though box plots are already exempt.
Panel C shows GSEA enrichment score line plots, which are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement since overlaying points on a running enrichment score curve is not meaningful.

Panel D is a bar chart of log2 fold-change values derived from a single differential gene expression (DEG) statistical test per gene (not a mean of independent biological replicates), so there are no discrete individual replicate values to overlay.
Panel E consists of representative H&E and IHC micrograph images, not a plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
